meetings.name: 11th Step Meditation Meeting
meetings.notes: This Open meeting welcomes everyone, but especially the Newcomer seeking the Spiritual Solution offered through working the Twelve Steps of Alcoholics Anonymous. You can expect a wide variety of 15-20 minute guided meditations (suitable for beginning + advanced meditators). We say the Third, Seventh, and Eleventh Step prayers from AA approved literature, and have open podium (sharing at will) directly after the meditation. As this is a meditation meeting where disruptions are unwelcome, please send an email to 11thStepMeditationMeeting@gmail.com to receive the passcode. If interested, by sharing your email address to our gmail account, you may ask to receive the link to the meditation in advance of the meeting. Many of our regulars have strong, long-term sobriety, and are available to sponsor. We deeply honor and respect diversity, equity, and inclusivity. If you are interested in recovery, we are here to help!

news.title: Understanding Alcoholics Anonymous and Spirituality
news.content: It is a common misconception that Alcoholics Anonymous is a religious-based or Christian organization, but that is not the case. In fact, a fundamental principle of A.A. is that the Fellowship is not affiliated with any religion, nor is it allied with any sect, denomination, politics, organization, or institution. In A.A., each person determines their own pathway in their recovery from alcoholism. Click here to read more.
